evidence.currency: Prefab709 cc.Toggle.checkEvents maps toggle1 to zCoin and toggle2 to coin. Their baked labels read 指尖币 and 游戏豆 respectively; SlyderWeeklyCardView._initMainView swaps icon_bag/iconGold with icon_bag2/iconGold3 by these native keys. Preview defaults coin (游戏豆).
evidence.title: Prefab709 main/title is the static lobby1023 pic_15 artwork 指尖币每日补充包. SlyderWeeklyCardView._initMainView lines526-527 only selects title or title2 by isGameOver; no currency-specific title replacement is present.
evidence.values: Amounts, ownership, duration and prices are server-derived in SlyderWeeklyCardView._initMainView / WeeklyCardView.init; no server response was collected.
